name: How long does it typically take to repair a kitchen door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to repair a kitchen door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most kitchen door frame repairs take between two and four hours to complete. Routine fixes, such as filling gouges, realigning loose hinges, or replacing an interior stop moulding, wrap up within a single morning or afternoon. If the work involves splicing in a new jamb bottom due to moisture damage, setting structural epoxy, or rehanging a heavy solid-core pantry door, the job can take closer to a full day. Additional time may be required if new paint or stain needs to cure before the door can be fully closed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most repairs take two to four hours. Extensive fixes involving wood splicing, jamb rebuilds, or curing finishes can take a full day.
